name: kwm-chat-ui-tailwind-g2
description: Web Engineering – Chat UI mit SCSS, BEM & Tailwind (@apply)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n sass,tailwind "sass styles/main.scss dist/styles.css --watch --no-source-map" "tailwindcss -i dist/styles.css -o dist/main.css --watch"
scripts.build: sass styles/main.scss dist/styles.css --no-source-map && tailwindcss -i dist/styles.css -o dist/main.css --minify
